announce_story.title: Announce a Story
announce_story.description: The announce agent's run for one wake: a Story's page went live or its rating changed. It re-reads the Story and decides from the records as they are now; it makes one Announcement and one email Delivery for the Story at a rung the site's agent policy allows, and sends what is due; a Delivery's approval wakes it to send only.

story.description: The Story's lineage id, from a Story's wake; empty on a Delivery's approval, which only sends

version.description: The version row the change was made on, from the wake

change.description: stage_entered (the page went live), rated, or approved (a person approved a Delivery), from the wake

what.description: What changed, as the wake key names it

stage.description: The stage the Story entered, from the wake

rate_items.title: Rate Unrated Stories
rate_items.description: The rating agent's daily run: reads the published Stories nobody has rated and decides three stars, four stars or a five-star candidate for each. It never writes a rating: at a rung the site's agent policy allows, it writes each as a suggestion beside the rating and raises the day's one review for a person.

review_deadline.title: Review Request Deadline
review_deadline.description: The engine's run for a soft review's deadline wake: it reads the review request again and, if it still waits for that deadline, records that it proceeded without review. Started by the request's follow-up timer with no adopted agent; an answer or withdrawal before the deadline means it does nothing.

reviewRequestId.description: The review request whose deadline came

dueAt.description: The deadline the wake was set for, a UTC instant
